technical_and_design_decisions: Follow existing Spring XD module patterns (Spark, RxJava) as references for U1 and U7 to ensure consistency.
Reuse the existing Maven multi-module layout and extend it to host the new isolated Hadoop test module for U5.
For U2, treat the Reactor 2.0 RC1 upgrade as a dependency/API migration with regression testing rather than a refactor.
For U3/U4, port the previous Spring XD field-value counter implementation directly and only address functional gaps in the current codebase.
For U6, use an Infrastructure-as-Code approach (e.g., CloudFormation or bash + AWS CLI) to provision the YARN cluster on EC2 deterministically.
For U8, expose the message size via a property bound from servers.yml using Spring's @ConfigurationProperties pattern.
Treat U3 and U4 as the same user story (duplicated in the specification) and consolidate their effort.
Keep per-module unit tests and a small set of integration tests; full end-to-end coverage is reserved for the YARN/EC2 acceptance story (U6).
All effort is performed by a single experienced Java/Spring developer familiar with Spring XD internals.
assumptions: One workday equals 8 productive hours of focused implementation work.
The base Spring XD project, build (Maven), CI pipeline, and source tree are already in place and understood.
A local Redis instance is available for development and testing of U3/U4.
AWS credentials, EC2 key pair, and a baseline AMI are available for U6; no new account or billing setup is required.
Reactor 2.0 RC1 API changes vs. the currently used Reactor version are limited to compile-time adjustments and do not require major architectural rework.
U3 and U4 are treated as a single requirement (the text is identical) to avoid double-counting.
Documentation updates are limited to reference/user docs for the affected modules; no new top-level guides are required.
No new third-party licenses or legal review are needed for the new modules.
Existing test infrastructure supports running the new and migrated tests without additional toolchain work.

activities.activity_description: Review the existing Spring XD module SPI, Spark/RxJava processor implementations, and Reactor 2.0 RC1 API; produce a short design note covering module option conventions, processor lifecycle, and integration points touched by U1, U2, U7, and U8.

Implement a new Reactor-based processor module: bare processor class wiring, module metadata, and the minimum set of well-known module option commands (e.g., input/output channel names, concurrency). Add unit tests and update module reference docs.

Update Maven dependency versions to Reactor 2.0 RC1, fix compile-time breakage in reactor-using modules, and run the affected integration tests to confirm behavior is preserved. Update any docs that reference the Reactor version.

Port the field-value counter aggregation specification from the previous Spring XD implementation into the current codebase, identify and close functional gaps, implement the Redis-backed counter store and aggregation sink/processor, write unit and integration tests against Redis, and update reference documentation.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Isolate Hadoop tests in a separate project
activities.activity_description: Create a new Maven module containing only Hadoop-related tests, move the existing Hadoop test sources into it, adjust parent and dependent module POMs so the main DIRT module no longer pulls Hadoop dependencies, verify the Eclipse classpath no longer contains the incorrect CP file, and re-run the affected test suites.

activities.activity_name: U6 - XD + YARN on EC2 acceptance tests
activities.activity_description: Implement acceptance test coverage for XD on YARN: provisioning scripts to launch the cluster on EC2, deployment of XD onto YARN, scripted verification of simple XD features (e.g., stream create, source/sink/processor), and integration of the acceptance job into the build cycle. Include documentation describing how to run the suite.

Implement a new RxJava-based processor module that lets users leverage RxJava APIs for data computations: processor class, module metadata, and unit tests following the same conventions as the Spark/RxJava reference modules. Add reference documentation.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Configurable HTTP source message size
activities.activity_description: Refactor the HTTP source module so the hard-coded 1MB limit in HttpChunkAggregator is replaced by a property bound from servers.yml, add validation and defaults, expose the new property in the reference documentation, and add unit/integration tests covering the override.

activities.activity_name: Cross-module integration testing and bug fixing
activities.activity_description: Run the full local test suite (excluding EC2 acceptance tests), triage and fix regressions introduced by the Reactor upgrade and the new modules, and verify module interaction with the existing stream DSL.

activities.activity_name: Final documentation pass and release prep
activities.activity_description: Consolidate reference docs, changelog, and release notes for all user stories in this increment; perform a final review of code, tests, and build configuration.
